Messages.Author: Ke.
Messages.Body:
Still somewhat jet lagged from the trip — but what an awesome trip it was.

A big thank you to all the organisers and players, I had a great time, met loads of awesome people and played many an epic game. Didn't quite go all the way — but there's always next year!

If any one is looking for a great week away, packed full of V:TES tournaments and friendly people I'd highly recommend clearing your schedule for this time next year — it's definitely worth the trip.

Ke

Amaranth Deck Building Tool :  VTES NZ :  VTES ANZ Facebook

Messages.Author: Pagan
Messages.Body:
It's great to see folks willing to travel that far to come to play some VTES at Origins, even if they steal my furthest traveled title.

Hope to see everyone there again next year, I think we still have a few characters left alive in the BSG Permadeath Series that Cally did not take out during the episode of BSG Natural Born Killers.
